manifest.title: Three dead after family get into difficulty in sea
manifest.summary: A man, a woman and a teenage girl die, and a younger girl is in critical condition, after swimming off Shoreham on the Sussex coast.

manifest.title: 'Everyone in for Christmas' - Burnham unveils rough sleeping plan
manifest.summary: Rough sleepers in England will be offered housing, in a move likened to the “Everyone In” initiative during the pandemic.

manifest.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
manifest.summary: Martial law has been in place in Ukraine since February 2022, under which elections are suspended.

manifest.title: Demand for degree apprenticeships in England quadruples in three years
manifest.summary: The popularity of degree apprenticeships has grown as the cost of university has come under increased scrutiny.

manifest.title: Camilla admits it was 'difficult' to keep King's cancer diagnosis a secret
manifest.summary: In a video to mark the 30th anniversary of Maggie's cancer charity, Queen Camilla speaks about her husband's own diagnosis.

manifest.title: Scientists stunned by children's lung recovery in ultra low emission zone
manifest.summary: Children's lung capacity caught up with their peers in less polluted areas once a clean air zone came in, a study shows.

manifest.title: French civil servant drugged us to make us urinate on ourselves, say accusers
manifest.summary: More than 200 women accuse Christian Nègre of drugging them to make them urinate - two share their stories.

manifest.title: Is another UK heatwave on the way in September?
manifest.summary: Some long range forecasts are suggesting autumn could be hotter and drier than average. Simon King explores whether a warm spell might be on the cards.

manifest.title: Suspended Reform UK member vows to fight to remain in party
manifest.summary: Tim Montgomerie says his appeal will be a test of whether the party can tolerate free speech.

manifest.title: Deaf patient given wrong jab due to sign language error, report says
manifest.summary: An ombudsman report says disabled people are being let down by a lack of accessible communication methods.
